Your risk tolerance 123: - Market volatility 124: - Trading style (scalp vs. swing) 125: - Backtest optimization 126: 127: --- 128: 129: ## 🔐 Security Best Practices 130: 131: ### Protect Your API Keys 132: 133: - ❌ **Never commit** `.env` files to Git 134: - ✅ **Use environment variables** for sensitive data 135: - ✅ **Rotate keys regularly** (every 3-6 months) 136: - ✅ **Use separate keys** for testing and production 137: - ✅ **Set IP whitelists** if your exchange supports it 138: 139: ### Webhook Security 140: 141: ```bash 142: # Add authentication to your webhook 143: WEBHOOK_SECRET=your_random_secret_here 144: ``` 145: 146: Then in TradingView alert message: 147: ```json 148: { 149: "secret": "your_random_secret_here", 150: "action": "buy", 151: "symbol": "BTCUSDT", 152: ... 153: } 154: ``` 155: 156: ### Server Security 157: 158: ```bash 159: # Use HTTPS (free with Let's Encrypt) 160: sudo certbot --nginx -d your-domain.com 161: 162: # Update webhook URL to: 163: https://your-domain.com/webhook 164: ``` 165: 166: --- 167: 168: ## 🧪 Testing 169: 170: ### Paper Trading (Recommended First) 171: 172: Test without risking real money: 173: 174: 1. **Use demo account** on Bybit: 175: -
